How does Docsumo's pricing work?
Docsumo offers three scalable plans to match your document processing needs:
Free plan offers a 14-day free trial with 1,000 pages, letting you experience AI-powered data extraction to help your team move beyond manual data entry.
Business plan adds intelligent classification, validation, and customization - perfect for businesses that are ready to scale automation across more users and complex workflows.
Enterprise plan unlocks full-blown automation with AI-led workflows, case management, real-time analytics, and enterprise-grade scalability for organizations running high-volume document operations.
How does Docsumo's pricing work?
Free Plan - This trial plan supports one user at a time, with 100 pages, allowing them to test the platform for 14 days at no cost.
Growth Plan - This plan provides 5,000 pages per month and suits fast-growing companies that are trying to automate their legacy operations. This is also free for the first 14 days.
Enterprise Plans - The pricing on this plan is entirely custom to support your specific use cases. The price reduces with higher volumes.
What payment methods do you offer?
We accept prepaid payments via credit or debit cards. We also support wire transfers for annual subscriptions.
What if my document type isn’t listed?
No worries! Train on your data with as little as 20 sample documents. Docsumo uses machine learning models that learn from your data to extract accurate information. You can also categorize tabular data to obtain analytics for automated decision-making. This way, you can customize the fields you need and get the JSON or Excel output for further analysis.
Is my data safe within Docsumo?
Keeping your data secure is our top priority, so we’ve built robust security measures into our platform. Docsumo is dedicated to protecting its clients' data and adheres to the highest industry standards (including GDPR, SOC 2, and HIPAA), ensuring the confidentiality of your documents. We also understand the potential risks associated with AI. That’s why Docsumo's tech stack is built entirely in-house, using millions of richly annotated documents and eliminating the chance of data leaks to third-party models. Read our
Privacy Policy
before you get started.
Can you handle 20+ pages in a document?
Sure, our software does exactly that! Docsumo can auto-classify files with multiple pages. By training a minimal set of documents, you can push multiple documents simultaneously, and our auto-classification API will figure out which document goes to which API.
Does Docsumo integrate with 3rd-party apps?
Yes, Docsumo integrates with any third-party applications. We offer API and webhook access for upstream (like email systems) and downstream integration (such as ERP) integration.
Do you offer discounts or free trials?
Yes, we offer free trials on our Free and Growth plans. Additionally, you can get up to a 10% discount on annual subscriptions.
Are there any set-up fees?
Set-up fees are charged in addition to your subscription plan. This fee is based on the complexity of processing the documents and the support required from the Docsumo team.
Are there any automatic charges?
Yes, the auto-debit (or the auto-pay) functionality is enabled for all the monthly recurring plans.
Is unused data carried over to the next month?
If you are on a monthly payment plan, unused monthly credits will NOT roll over to the next month. If you are on an annual subscription, you will be given all credits upfront, which you can use anytime during the subscription term.
How can I cancel my plan?
We understand priorities change. While we’d hate to see you go, you can cancel your Docsumo subscription at any time. Just notify our support team at least 30 days in advance.
How can I upgrade my plan?
Docsumo allows you to upgrade your plans anytime. All you have to do is contact:
